lines.zh: 石足碾过深层岩道，声音很闷。
lines.en: Stone feet grind the deep tunnels; the echo stays low.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，岩石替我计时。
lines.en: Step by step I close in; the rock keeps my count.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的腿比你想象的耐久。
lines.en: Do not run; my legs outlast anything you can do.

lines.zh: 深层没有路，只有我咬出来的洞。
lines.en: There are no roads here, only holes my teeth made.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石是我上一顿的残渣。
lines.en: The gravel underfoot is what my last meal left.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可方向从不变。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my direction never changes.

lines.zh: 洞顶在滴水，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Water drips overhead; I cannot be bothered to look.

lines.zh: 你听见石头磨石头的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear stone grinding against stone behind you?

lines.zh: 三十颗心的重量压在这条路上。
lines.en: Thirty hearts of weight press down on this path.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的脚印，像顺着矿脉。
lines.en: I follow your tracks the way I follow ore veins.

lines.zh: 别回头看，我就在你影子里磨牙。
lines.en: Do not turn around; I am grinding teeth in your shadow.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过一千次，闭眼也行。
lines.en: I have walked this path a thousand times blind.

lines.zh: 我啃了一口岩壁，味道还行。
lines.en: I bit the wall once; the flavor was acceptable.

lines.zh: 盔甲镀层藏在哪里？我闻得到。
lines.en: Where is the armor plating? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 深层很安静，只有我在咀嚼。
lines.en: The Deeplands are quiet except for my chewing.

lines.zh: 我数着钟乳石，数到第七根就忘了。
lines.en: I count stalactites and forget at the seventh.

lines.zh: 牙齿钝了，得找块好石头磨磨。
lines.en: My teeth are dull; I need a good stone to sharpen them.

lines.zh: 血在石头里流，谁看得见呢。
lines.en: Blood runs inside the stone; who would notice?

lines.zh: 我坐着不动，也像一块岩石。
lines.en: Sitting still, I pass for a boulder.

lines.zh: 有东西在洞深处敲，不是我。
lines.en: Something knocks deeper in the cave, and it is not me.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，连影子都想咬一口。
lines.en: When hungry, I would bite even my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我在等猎物自己撞上岩壁。
lines.en: I wait for prey to walk into the wall.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，比石头香。
lines.en: The iron smell on you is sweeter than stone.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在量你的骨。
lines.en: You look at me; I measure your bones.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我想看清你哪里软。
lines.en: Do not blink; I want to see where you are soft.

lines.zh: 你比我矮半个头，够不着洞顶。
lines.en: You are half a head shorter than the ceiling.

lines.zh: 瞳孔在暗处放大，我看得很清。
lines.en: My pupils widen in the dark; I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你手上那层护甲，是给我的吗？
lines.en: That armor on your hands, is it for me?

lines.zh: 第一次有东西敢和我对视。
lines.en: This is the first thing to meet my eyes.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，石头听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing slipped; the stone heard it.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，慢慢记的。
lines.en: I have your face memorized, slowly, piece by piece.

lines.zh: 看够了吗？我还没看够。
lines.en: Done looking? I am not done looking at you.

lines.zh: 你凿掉了我肩上一块石。
lines.en: You chipped a stone off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 会疼，但疼不耽误我咬你。
lines.en: It hurts, but pain does not stop my bite.

lines.zh: 你的武器比我想的硬一点。
lines.en: Your weapon is a little harder than I thought.

lines.zh: 别高兴，掉的是外壳。
lines.en: Do not celebrate; that was only my outer shell.

lines.zh: 石头也会疼，只是不吭声。
lines.en: Stone feels pain too, it just stays quiet.

lines.zh: 这一击，我在壳上刻了个记。
lines.en: That blow, I carved a mark into my shell.

lines.zh: 血从裂缝里渗出来，很慢。
lines.en: Blood seeps from the crack, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你还想再来一次？我等着。
lines.en: Want to try that again? I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，脚跟没动。
lines.en: I swayed once; my heels did not move.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我用伤口记下了。
lines.en: I wrote your name down with a wound.

lines.zh: 你晃的那块金属，扔过来。
lines.en: That piece of metal you wave, throw it here.

lines.zh: 我不吃草，我吃会响的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat plants; I eat things that clink.

lines.zh: 你手里的镀层，闻着像晚饭。
lines.en: The plating in your hand smells like dinner.

lines.zh: 别拿食物逗我，我要的是铁。
lines.en: Do not tease me with food; I want iron.

lines.zh: 你放下它，我就少咬你一口。
lines.en: Set it down and I will bite you one time less.

lines.zh: 石头我吃腻了，换点硬的。
lines.en: I am tired of stone; give me something harder.

lines.zh: 那块矿石在我牙里会更亮。
lines.en: That ore would shine brighter between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你越举高，我越想吃掉它。
lines.en: The higher you hold it, the more I want it.

lines.zh: 我不是贪心，我只是饿得久。
lines.en: I am not greedy, only hungry for a long time.

lines.zh: 把铁留下，人可以走。
lines.en: Leave the iron; the person may go.

lines.zh: 撞上来？你自己找的。
lines.en: You bumped into me? You chose that.

lines.zh: 撞在石壳上，你的盾先裂。
lines.en: Hit my stone shell and your shield cracks first.

lines.zh: 别推，我几乎挪不动。
lines.en: Do not shove; I barely move at all.

lines.zh: 你弹开了，石头纹丝不动。
lines.en: You bounced off; the stone did not shift.

lines.zh: 这一撞，算你替我挠痒。
lines.en: That bump counts as scratching my itch.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，是想让我咬吗？
lines.en: Standing this close, do you want to be bitten?

lines.zh: 我身上掉下的碎屑能砸疼你。
lines.en: The chips falling off me can bruise you.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，你偏要挤我这块。
lines.en: The path is wide, yet you squeeze past me.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我只是灰尘的事。
lines.en: A collision is only a matter of dust to me.

lines.zh: 又撞？我的壳可不认道歉。
lines.en: Ram me again; my shell does not accept apologies.

lines.zh: 石头不需要伴侣，只需要时间。
lines.en: Stone needs no mate, only time.

lines.zh: 我从石头里来，也会回石头里去。
lines.en: I came from stone and will return to it.

lines.zh: 没有同伴，我的牙也够用。
lines.en: Without a companion, my teeth are still enough.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁的壳硬。
lines.en: When kin meet, we first compare shell hardness.

lines.zh: 深层里的孩子都是自己长出来的。
lines.en: In the Deeplands, children grow out of the rock alone.

lines.zh: 我这一身石头，传不下去的。
lines.en: This stone body of mine cannot be passed on.

lines.zh: 你问我爱不爱？我只懂饿。
lines.en: You ask if I love? I only understand hunger.

lines.zh: 另一块岩石在远处磨牙，随它。
lines.en: Another rock grinds its teeth far off; let it.

lines.zh: 洞穴很宽，容得下两个独居者。
lines.en: The cave is wide enough for two who live alone.

lines.zh: 没有谁等我回家，洞就是家。
lines.en: Nobody waits for me; the cave is home.

lines.zh: 这块镀层归我了，别抢。
lines.en: This plating is mine now; do not grab it.

lines.zh: 镀层碎屑我一颗颗捡起来。
lines.en: I gather every flake of armor plating.

lines.zh: 亮的东西？放嘴里试试。
lines.en: Something shiny? Let me try it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你掉的铁片，我替你收着。
lines.en: The iron scrap you dropped, I will keep it.

lines.zh: 捡起来才发现，咬不动。
lines.en: Now that I picked it up, I find it will not crack.

lines.zh: 东西进了我的爪子就出不去。
lines.en: Once in my claws, nothing gets out.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿能补我的壳吗？
lines.en: Can this thing patch my shell?

lines.zh: 我收藏的都是硬东西。
lines.en: Everything I collect is hard.

lines.zh: 别从我爪缝里掏，会少手指。
lines.en: Do not dig in my claws; you will lose fingers.

lines.zh: 石头堆高一点，我睡得踏实。
lines.en: Pile the stones higher and I sleep better.

lines.zh: 你进洞了，就是我的事。
lines.en: You entered the cave; now you are my business.

lines.zh: 七点攻击，够凿开你的甲。
lines.en: Seven points of force will crack your armor.

lines.zh: 我闻到心跳，就在左边。
lines.en: I smell a heartbeat, just to my left.

lines.zh: 先别跑，我得记住你的鞋印。
lines.en: Hold still; I need to remember your boot prints.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，岩石开始发热。
lines.en: Target locked; the stone starts to warm.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块石头，是我兄弟。
lines.en: The stone you crushed was kin to me.

lines.zh: 牙齿先动，脑子后到。
lines.en: My teeth move first; my mind arrives later.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，深层作证。
lines.en: I have marked you, the Deeplands bear witness.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，我身上有牙。
lines.en: You carry iron; I carry teeth.

lines.zh: 别躲在柱子后面，我看得见。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the pillar; I can see you.

lines.zh: 追你这段路，我走得很稳。
lines.en: This chase, I walk it with steady feet.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就更近了。
lines.en: Every time you turn, I am closer.

lines.zh: 三十颗心的耐心，够追你很久。
lines.en: Thirty hearts of patience will last this hunt.

lines.zh: 跑吧，让我听听你的脚步。
lines.en: Run; let me hear your footsteps.

lines.zh: 深层的地面，我比你熟。
lines.en: I know the deeplands' floor better than you do.

lines.zh: 你敲石头的声音，把我引来了。
lines.en: The sound of you chipping stone drew me here.

lines.zh: 你的喘气在洞里绕了三圈。
lines.en: Your panting circles the cave three times.

lines.zh: 三步之内，你归我的牙管。
lines.en: Within three steps, you belong to my teeth.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子走，别回头。
lines.en: I walk in your shadow; do not look back.

lines.zh: 你挡在洞中央，正好方便我。
lines.en: You stand mid-cave, which suits me well.

lines.zh: 深层没有光，我也不需要。
lines.en: The Deeplands have no light, and I need none.

lines.zh: 你越退，岩壁越靠你后背。
lines.en: The more you retreat, the closer the wall gets.

lines.zh: 别摆架势，我只认距离。
lines.en: Skip the stance; I only care about distance.

lines.zh: 我听见你的剑在抖。
lines.en: I hear your sword trembling.

lines.zh: 你退一步，洞壁就更近一寸。
lines.en: Each step back brings the cave wall an inch closer.

lines.zh: 这一口，从你膝盖开始。
lines.en: This bite starts at your knees.

lines.zh: 你抬手的样子，太慢了。
lines.en: The way you raise your arm is too slow.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己走进范围。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to step into range.

lines.zh: 洞口的风把你的味道吹过来。
lines.en: The cave wind carries your scent to me.

lines.zh: 你只剩一条路，朝我这边。
lines.en: You have one path left, and it comes at me.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一步一块石。
lines.en: I count your steps, one stone apiece.

lines.zh: 我把你往深处赶，那里更黑。
lines.en: I herd you deeper, where it is darker.

lines.zh: 你的靴底在碎石上打滑。
lines.en: Your boot soles slip on the scree.

lines.zh: 我不用看，声音就够了。
lines.en: I need not look; sound is enough.

lines.zh: 你退到我的老窝门口了。
lines.en: You have backed up to my old den's door.

lines.zh: 这一带的岩壁，全是我咬的。
lines.en: Every wall here bears my teeth marks.

lines.zh: 咬住了，别指望我松口。
lines.en: Bitten. Do not expect me to let go.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我牙下响了一声。
lines.en: Your armor rang once under my teeth.

lines.zh: 七点力道，专找骨缝。
lines.en: Seven points of force, aimed at the joints.

lines.zh: 这一口带石粉，你尝到了吗？
lines.en: This bite carries stone dust; can you taste it?

lines.zh: 我倒要看看你的甲有多厚。
lines.en: Let me see exactly how thick your armor is.

lines.zh: 用盾挡？牙会连盾一起咬。
lines.en: Block with a shield? My teeth take both.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我咬第二步。
lines.en: You take one step back; I bite on the second.

lines.zh: 骨头裂的声音，比石头脆。
lines.en: Bones crack sharper than stone.

lines.zh: 我咬你，不是恨你，是饿。
lines.en: I bite you not from hate but from hunger.

lines.zh: 这块肉比岩壁软多了。
lines.en: This meat is far softer than the cave wall.

lines.zh: 你甩开我？牙还留在里面。
lines.en: Shake me off? My teeth are still inside.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，你的甲就掉了。
lines.en: One more hit and your armor comes off.

lines.zh: 我咬得很慢，是为了尝清楚。
lines.en: I bite slowly so I can taste it properly.

lines.zh: 你流的血，把石头染热了。
lines.en: Your blood warms the stone where it falls.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，把你的盾顶歪。
lines.en: I ram and knock your shield askew.

lines.zh: 牙嵌进甲缝，我拧一下。
lines.en: My teeth sink into a plate seam, and I twist.

lines.zh: 碎石混着血，落在我脚边。
lines.en: Grit and blood fall at my feet.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，手腕就归我了。
lines.en: Raise a hand to block and the wrist is mine.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，直到你软。
lines.en: I hold the bite until you go limp.

lines.zh: 这一下从下往上，掀你的膝。
lines.en: This one comes low and flips your knee.

lines.zh: 岩石裂开，我从缝里出来。
lines.en: The rock splits; I come out of the seam.

lines.zh: 深层又多了一张嘴。
lines.en: The Deeplands have one more mouth now.

lines.zh: 醒来第一件事，是找吃的。
lines.en: First thing on waking is finding food.

lines.zh: 我出生时背着一层碎石。
lines.en: I was born with rubble layered on my back.

lines.zh: 谁把我吵醒的？站出来。
lines.en: Who woke me? Step forward.

lines.zh: 洞里的空气忽然变重了。
lines.en: The air in the cave just got heavier.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这具身体还是新的。
lines.en: I checked; this body is still new.

lines.zh: 脚下的地面还没认熟。
lines.en: The ground under me is still unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 三十颗心开始跳了，很响。
lines.en: Thirty hearts start beating, and they are loud.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着牙，不用学。
lines.en: I was born with teeth; no lessons needed.

lines.zh: 这层岩壁是我压碎的。
lines.en: I crushed this layer of rock on my way out.

lines.zh: 有人在外面走动，正好。
lines.en: Someone is walking outside; convenient.

lines.zh: 火烤我的壳，味道更焦了。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; the smell turns burnt.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下，石头也散。
lines.en: Falling this far scatters even stone.

lines.zh: 水里我动不了，只能沉。
lines.en: In water I cannot move; I only sink.

lines.zh: 震得我耳朵里全是沙子。
lines.en: The blast fills my ears with sand.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进我的岩层里。
lines.en: Something lodged itself into my rock layers.

lines.zh: 这道光钻透了我的壳。
lines.en: That light drilled straight through my shell.

lines.zh: 饿极了，我啃洞壁的石灰。
lines.en: Starving, I gnaw the lime off the cave wall.

lines.zh: 雷把我的裂缝照得透亮。
lines.en: Lightning lit every crack in me.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，石头也留不住。
lines.en: Fallen into the void, even stone cannot hold.
